focus: Campaign progression blockers, especially occupied world nodes after route switches

findings.problem: Switching away from an occupied road and back forgets the current route's entry road. World travel, probability retreat and timeout retreat all lose the legal exit.
reproduction: Native new_game -> next_chapter(1) -> recruit Mae -> next_chapter(2).
Alm travels castle52 -> 16 -> occupied17. Switch to Celica; travel18 -> occupied19.
Save via production writer to isolated report save, reload via production reader, switch back to Alm.
Before fix previous_world_node is set to17 although the source entry was16. world_neighbors=[]; retreat_destination17; roll0 cannot offer retreat; map17 turn40 timeout returns missing_player_origin.
findings.root_cause: A single previous_world_node is reused between routes, and switch_route replaces it with the target's current position. Source previous-node table $6D16,X is per player route/army.
source: src/bank006.asm L06B7C6-L06B7C9: player route index selects $6D16,X for timeout retreat.
src/bank006.asm L068907-L068921: encounter return also selects source previous-node table.
findings.fix: GameState remembers and restores independent per-route entry nodes and incoming-army context; production save/load and retry retain them. Scenario first Celica altar handoff calls the same remember/restore helpers.

findings.problem: The active route's enemy-initiated encounter flags could be reused after switching to another party already standing on an enemy road, so retreats could select the wrong initiator and army.
findings.evidence: Before-fix code inspection showed switch_route retained the four global inventory encounter flags. After-fix executable case allocates a legal group64 army at29, real travel27->28 moves it onto Alm, switches to Celica's player-initiated19, saves/reloads it, switches back and times out the native stacked battle28.
findings.fix: The same per-route encounter helper retains the real allocated attacking instance and restores or clears the four flags for the target route.
findings.verification: Celica keeps source previous18/player initiative; Alm restores its incoming allocated army; timeout moves only that army to29 while stationary forest28 defenders remain.
